title: Expanded ad network protection
message: Version 3.8.0 adds 27 bundled network filters for additional advertising, sponsored-content, measurement, and tracking endpoints. Cosmetic and in-stream video ad coverage remains platform-dependent.
features: Expanded bundled ad filter from 57 to 84 network rules
Keeps document-start cleanup and dynamic page monitoring
Existing tracker, privacy, miner and user filter controls remain available
No remote executable code is downloaded
